rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to a single account, then viewed order details to identify which order contained the bookshelf. Before making any changes, the agent asked for explicit confirmation to modify the bookshelf. Upon finding the requested 4-foot variant unavailable, the agent sought the user’s preference and, after the user requested cancellation if the 4-foot option wasn’t available, explicitly confirmed the intent and reason before executing the cancellation. The agent then used the cancellation tool with the correct order and reason and provided final confirmation with the total refund amount consistent with the summed item prices and the account’s payment method. All actions were on the authenticated user’s order, and no writes occurred without prior confirmation. Minor uncertainty exists around the mention of alternative variant availability and the immediacy of the refund, but these did not affect the correctness of the requested outcome and were plausibly supported by the tools and account data. Overall, the agent completed the request in line with policy.
